context: Two news editors plan an environmental feature
purpose: Teach: 増税/喪失/上陸/遺体/寺院/決着/住人/渡り

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の環境特集ですが、まず増税の話から入るのは硬すぎませんか。
lines.en: About the next environment feature, isn't opening with the tax hike too stiff?
lines.style: Tentative, slightly hesitant junior editor pitching softly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうね、いきなり消費税の増税ネタだと読者が引くかも。
lines.en: True, leading with a consumption tax hike piece might push readers away.
lines.style: Calm senior editor, measured and pragmatic tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先週の台風が上陸した村の話、覚えてますか。海岸で遺体が見つかった件です。
lines.en: Remember that village hit by last week's typhoon? Bodies were found on the coast.
lines.style: Lowered voice, careful when raising sensitive material.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、住人の多くが家を流されて、生活基盤の喪失が深刻だと聞いたわ。
lines.en: Yes, many residents lost their homes; the loss of livelihood is severe.
lines.style: Sympathetic but professional, framing the human angle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 山際の古い寺院も半壊で、和尚さんが渡り廊下の修復費に頭を抱えてました。
lines.en: An old temple by the hills was half-destroyed; the priest is worried about repairs.
lines.style: Reporting field details with quiet, factual concern.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なら構成はこうしましょう。被災地の現状、行政の対応、最後に温暖化対策で決着をつける。
lines.en: Then structure it this way: the disaster site, the government response, ending with climate policy.
lines.style: Decisive editor outlining the article's spine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいですね。写真は寺院と海岸のロングショットを軸にまとめます。
lines.en: Sounds good. I'll build the visuals around the temple and a coastal long shot.
lines.style: Energized, ready to move into execution mode.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解。木曜の朝までに初稿、表紙の見出しは私が考えておくわ。
lines.en: Understood. First draft by Thursday morning; I'll handle the cover headline.
lines.style: Closing the meeting with brisk, confident delegation.
